title: Sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring inequalities for matrix potentials
summary: We prove the sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring inequality for every finite matrix size and every exponent $`1/2\lt \gamma\lt 3/2`$. The optimal constant is the scalar one-bound-state constant, independently of the matrix size. The inequality bounds the full sum of negative eigenvalue moments for every measurable Hermitian positive semidefinite potential W satisfying $`\int_\mathbb R\mathop{\mathrm{tr}}\nolimits (W^{\gamma+1/2})\lt \infty`$. The matrices may have arbitrary rank and need not commute at different points.
family_title: Sharp finite-matrix Lieb–Thirring inequalities and all equality cases
